signage.title: Signage
signage.summary: Design, fabrication and installation of every kind of sign.
signage.detail: From concept through to the bolt in the wall: shop fascias, illuminated boxes, built-up letters and free-standing totems, all made in our own workshop and fitted by our own crews.

vehicle-graphics.title: Vehicle graphics
vehicle-graphics.summary: Turning vehicles into advertising that works while parked.
vehicle-graphics.detail: Cast vinyl applied to one van or a fleet of forty, laid out so the message reads at speed and from an angle. It protects the paint underneath and comes off without residue.

print-vinyl.title: Print & vinyl
print-vinyl.summary: Digital printing onto almost any surface, at almost any size.
print-vinyl.detail: Large and small format printing on vinyl, mesh, fabric and paper, with stock rated for the life the job actually needs — a week on a hoarding or seven years on a shopfront.

engraving-cutting.title: Engraving & cutting
engraving-cutting.summary: Laser and CNC work to millimetre accuracy.
engraving-cutting.detail: Cutting and engraving acrylic, aluminium, timber and composite panel. We work for end clients and as a trade supplier to other workshops needing contract cutting.

building-cladding.title: Building cladding
building-cladding.summary: Renewing a frontage in aluminium composite panel.
building-cladding.detail: Bond panels cut and folded on our CNC, hung on a ventilated subframe. It changes a building's face completely, and lets us design the signage into the panel grid from the start.

promotional-events.title: Promotional & events
promotional-events.summary: Everything a stand, campaign or launch needs.
promotional-events.detail: Modular exhibition builds that travel in flight cases, plus the road signage, print and merchandise around them. Designed to go up fast and be used again.

maintenance-repair.title: Maintenance & repair
maintenance-repair.summary: Keeping signage working — including signs we did not build.
maintenance-repair.detail: Scheduled servicing, LED conversions, repainting and emergency call-outs after storm or accident damage. We tell you honestly when a repair beats a replacement.

About.title: Twenty years of getting it made properly.
About.body: Focus Signs has been designing, printing and fabricating signage out of Paphos for over two decades. What started as a small sign workshop now covers everything from illuminated shopfronts to full building façades — still run out of the same city, still hands-on with every job that leaves the workshop.

About.storyTitle: From a single sign bench to a full fabrication shop.
About.storyP1: Focus Signs opened in Paphos in 2005 with one vinyl plotter and a short list of local clients. The work was simple then — shopfront lettering, a few vehicle doors, the occasional banner. What kept the phone ringing was not the equipment but the habit of finishing properly: straight lines, clean edges, fixings that held.
About.storyP2: Two decades later the same workshop runs UV and latex printers, a laser cutter, a CNC router and a fabrication bay for composite panel work. The client list has grown from single shopfronts to hotel groups, developers, municipalities and national franchises — but the jobs still get measured, made and installed by the same people who quoted them.
About.storyP3: We stayed in Paphos on purpose. Being local means we can survey a site in the morning, prototype in the afternoon and be back on site to install without shipping anything across the island. It also means we live with our own work — you'll see our signage on the way to the workshop every day, which is a strong incentive to get it right.

About.processTitle: Five steps from enquiry to installed.
About.processSubtitle: No mystery, no handoffs to a third party. Here's exactly what happens after you send a brief.

brief.title: Brief & quote
brief.body: You describe the job — or send a photo of the wall, the van, the unit. We come back with a scoped, itemised quote, usually within one working day.

survey.title: Site survey
survey.body: For anything installed, we measure on site: substrate, access, power routes, fixings and any planning constraints. Guessing dimensions is how signage ends up crooked.

design.title: Design & proof
design.body: You get a visual mock-up on your actual building or vehicle, not a generic template. Nothing goes to production until you've approved the proof.

fabrication.title: Fabrication
fabrication.body: Printing, cutting, routing, welding and assembly all happen in our Paphos workshop, so we control quality and timeline rather than chasing a supplier.

install.title: Installation & aftercare
install.body: Our own team installs, tests the electrics and cleans up. We keep your artwork on file so replacements and additions match years later.

About.capabilitiesSubtitle: Owning the equipment means shorter lead times and no minimum order dictated by someone else's production schedule.

printing.title: Wide-format printing
printing.body: UV and latex printing on rigid and flexible media, up to large-scale panels and full building wraps.

laser.title: Laser cutting & engraving
laser.body: Precision cutting and etching of acrylic, wood and coated metals for plaques, letters and detailed components.

cnc.title: CNC routing
cnc.body: Routed letterforms, shaped panels and composite fabrication with repeatable tolerances across a production run.

fabrication.title: Metal & panel fabrication
fabrication.body: Aluminium trays, folded returns and ACM/Bond composite panel systems built for outdoor conditions.

electrical.title: LED & illumination
electrical.body: Face-lit, halo-lit and edge-lit builds with IP-rated drivers specified for continuous outdoor use.

installation.title: Survey & installation
installation.body: Our own installation crews, working at height where needed, with fixings chosen for the actual substrate.

About.materialsTitle: Chosen for Cyprus, not for a catalogue photo.
About.materialsBody: UV exposure, salt air and summer heat destroy signage that was specified for a milder climate. We default to materials that survive here: cast vinyls rather than calendered films on curved vehicle panels, UV-stable acrylics, marine-grade fixings near the coast, and powder-coated or anodised aluminium instead of untreated steel. If a cheaper build makes sense for a short-term campaign, we'll say so — and tell you how long it will realistically last.
About.materialsList: Aluminium composite (ACM / Bond) · Cast and calendered vinyl · UV-stable acrylic · Powder-coated aluminium · Dibond · Foamex · Mesh and PVC banner · Stainless fixings

About.faqSubtitle: Still unsure about something? Send us the question directly — we answer quotes and queries the same way.

leadTime.q: How long does a signage job take?
leadTime.a: Simple printed work such as banners or window graphics is usually ready in 2–4 working days. Fabricated and illuminated signs typically run 2–3 weeks from approved artwork, depending on materials and whether installation at height is required. Full building cladding is quoted per project after a site survey. If you have a fixed deadline, tell us up front and we'll confirm before you commit.

areas.a: Yes. The workshop is in Paphos and we install across Cyprus, including Limassol, Nicosia, Larnaca and the Famagusta district. Travel for installation outside the Paphos district is included in the quote so there are no surprises afterwards.

permits.q: Do I need permission for an exterior sign?
permits.a: Often yes — exterior signage in Cyprus can require municipal approval, and listed or tourist-zone buildings have extra restrictions. We tell you during the quote whether your sign is likely to need consent, and we can supply the drawings and specifications your application will ask for.

design.q: Can you design the sign, or do I need to supply artwork?
design.a: Either works. Send print-ready artwork and we'll use it, or give us your logo and we'll design the layout. Every job gets a visual proof on a photo of your actual building or vehicle before anything goes to production.

materials.q: What materials do you recommend for outdoor signage in Cyprus?
materials.a: For anything permanent outdoors we specify UV-stable acrylics, composite aluminium panels, cast vinyl on curved surfaces and marine-grade fixings near the coast. Cheaper films and untreated steel look identical on day one and fail within a season or two under Cyprus sun and salt air.

maintenance.q: Do you repair or maintain existing signs?
maintenance.a: Yes, including signage we didn't originally build. Common jobs are LED and driver replacement, re-facing an existing tray with new branding, and re-fixing panels after storm damage. Re-facing is usually far cheaper than a complete rebuild.

pricing.q: Why are there no prices on the website?
pricing.a: Because size, material, illumination, quantity and installation access change the cost far more than the product name does. Add what you need to the quote list and send it over — you'll get an itemised price for your actual job, usually within one working day.

languages.q: Can you produce signage in Greek and Russian?
languages.a: Yes. We work daily in English, Greek and Russian, including multilingual signage and correctly typeset Greek and Cyrillic — which matters, because auto-translated or badly kerned text is immediately obvious to native readers.

retail.title: Retail
retail.tagline: Storefronts that get found and get walked into.
retail.intro: Retail signage has one job: get someone off the street and through the door. We build fascia signs, window graphics and floor wayfinding that read clearly from a moving car and hold up to daily foot traffic.

hospitality.title: Hospitality & Hotels
hospitality.tagline: Wayfinding and branding for guests who don't know the building yet.
hospitality.intro: Hotels and resorts need signage a first-time guest can follow without asking — entrance monuments, room and floor numbering, and façade branding that matches the property's positioning, indoors and out.

restaurants.title: Restaurants & Cafés
restaurants.tagline: Menus, façades and window graphics that earn a second look.
restaurants.intro: A restaurant's signage sets the price expectation before anyone reads the menu. We produce illuminated fascias, window vinyl and banners built to survive kitchen heat, sea air and constant cleaning.

corporate.title: Corporate & Offices
corporate.tagline: Reception branding, wayfinding and site identity.
corporate.intro: Reception signage, meeting room numbering, directional systems and site identity for offices, business parks and industrial sites — designed to read as considered, not improvised.

healthcare.title: Healthcare & Clinics
healthcare.tagline: Clear wayfinding where confusion has a real cost.
healthcare.intro: Clinics and healthcare sites need wayfinding that works under stress — clear directional signage, department numbering and window graphics that meet privacy needs without feeling clinical.
